meta.title: Rappespalter: your money, on your computer
meta.description: A free, open-source personal finance app for Switzerland. Import your bank statements, see where every franc goes and plan your way to retirement. Everything stays on your own computer.
hero.badge: In beta · free and open source
hero.badgeVersion: Beta · version {version} · free and open source
hero.title:
Your money.
Your computer.
hero.lead: Rappespalter is a personal finance app for Switzerland. Import your bank statements, see where every franc goes and plan your way to retirement. No account, no cloud: everything stays on your own machine.
hero.meta: Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux · MIT license
hero.video: A 30-second tour of Rappespalter, with made-up demo data
tiles.label: Rappespalter in numbers
tiles.cloud: bytes of your data in the cloud
features.title: What your bank app doesn't tell you
features.lead: Spending, budgets, net worth, investments and retirement, in one place and in francs.
f.dashboard.title: Every month at a glance
f.dashboard.text: Income, expenses, savings and what's left, with a money-flow chart from salary to the last coffee. Click any figure to see the transactions behind it.
f.dashboard.alt: The dashboard: income, expenses, saved and net tiles above a money-flow chart
f.import.title: Drop in your bank export
f.import.text: Raiffeisen Finanzassistent exports, or camt.053 and camt.054 statements from any Swiss bank. Transfers between your own accounts are recognised, and importing the same file twice adds nothing twice.
f.import.alt: The import page with a drop zone for bank statements
f.budgets.title: Plans that meet reality
f.budgets.text: Set a monthly limit per category and compare it with what you really spent over the last 3, 6 or 12 months. Mid-month, the dashboard tells you where you're heading while there's still time to react.
f.budgets.alt: Budgets compared with the average actual spending per category
f.networth.title: Watch your wealth grow
f.networth.text: Accounts, ETFs, Säule 3a and 2. Säule, plus everything else you own or owe: gold, crypto, a car, a mortgage. Split into money you can reach and money that's locked away.
f.networth.alt: Net worth over time, stacked by asset class
f.portfolio.title: Know what your ETFs really hold
f.portfolio.text: Import your broker's activity export for returns, dividends, fees and drift from your target allocation. The look-through shows the companies, countries and currencies inside your funds.
f.portfolio.alt: Portfolio value over time compared with net deposits
f.projections.title: See where you'll be at 65
f.projections.text: Your balances and monthly savings, compounded until retirement. Try other returns, contributions or retirement ages, in today's francs, without touching your settings.
f.projections.alt: Projected wealth by age until retirement
more.title: And a lot more
more.goals.title: Savings goals
more.goals.text: A home, travel, a wedding: each goal follows your real savings pace.
more.rules.title: Auto-categorisation
more.rules.text: “Counterparty contains Migros → Groceries”. Rules sort new imports for you.
more.trends.title: Trends and income
more.trends.text: Savings rate and cash flow over time, and income broken down by source.
more.tax.title: Tax estimate
more.tax.text: Income and wealth tax for your municipality, from the federal tax calculator.
more.data.title: Your data, browsable
more.data.text: A built-in table of every transaction, with filters and quick re-categorising.
more.backup.title: Backup and restore
more.backup.text: One file holds everything. Moving to a new computer takes a minute.
more.updates.title: Updates on your terms
more.updates.text: The app tells you about a new version and installs it only when you say so.
more.theme.title: Day and night
more.theme.text: A light and a dark theme, and less motion if you prefer.
swiss.title: Speaks franc, Säule 3a and camt.053
swiss.lead: Most finance apps are built for somewhere else. Rappespalter starts from how money works here, and the core works for anyone who wants to track spending and savings.
swiss.chf: Amounts in francs, written the Swiss way: Fr. 1'234.50
swiss.pillars: Säule 3a and 2. Säule in your net worth and your retirement forecast
swiss.banks: Raiffeisen exports, plus camt.053 and camt.054 statements from any Swiss bank
swiss.tax: Tax estimates from the Swiss Federal Tax Administration's calculator
privacy.title: Nothing leaves your computer
privacy.lead: Your statements, transactions, balances and forecasts live in a database file on your own machine. Bank files are read there and never uploaded.
privacy.online.title: Three features go online. Here's exactly what they send.
privacy.online.portfolioSends: Ticker symbols, fund ISINs, currency codes and date ranges, to Yahoo Finance, the European Central Bank and fund providers.
privacy.online.taxSends: Municipality, tax year, household details, net income and taxable wealth, to the federal tax calculator. Only when you click to estimate.
privacy.online.updatesSends: An ordinary request to GitHub for the latest version number. Nothing about you or your data.
privacy.online.note: None of them ever sends your transactions, balances, holdings or amounts. If you don't use the portfolio or the tax estimate, the app never contacts those services.
download.title: Get Rappespalter
download.lead: Free, no sign-up. Install it, import a bank statement and your first month is there.
download.windows.note: The installer isn't signed yet, so Windows warns the first time: choose “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
download.mac.note: Signed and notarised by Apple. There's no build for Intel Macs yet.
download.beta: Rappespalter is in beta: it works, but it hasn't been fully tested yet. Make a backup now and then (Settings → Backup & restore), and please report anything that looks wrong.
contribute.title: Built in the open. Make it yours.
contribute.lead: Rappespalter is MIT licensed. Read the code, run it from source, change it to fit your life and send the improvements back.
contribute.runNote: Needs Node.js 22 or newer and pnpm. The README covers the details, the desktop build included.
contribute.banks.title: Add your bank
contribute.banks.text: camt statements work everywhere. A parser for another bank's export makes importing even easier.
contribute.translate.title: Polish the translations
contribute.translate.text: German, French and Italian are in. Native speakers reviewing the wording help a lot.
contribute.assets.title: Teach it new things
contribute.assets.text: New asset kinds, brokers and charts. The docs explain how the pieces fit together.
contribute.issues.title: Report bugs and ideas
contribute.issues.text: Something looks wrong, or you're missing a feature? Open an issue.
name.title: Why “Rappespalter”?
name.text: It's Swiss German for a penny-pincher: someone who would split a Rappen in two. Fitting for an app that knows where every one of them went.
footer.license: Open source under the MIT license.
footer.disclaimer: Rappespalter is a tool, not financial advice. Screenshots show made-up demo data.
footer.site: This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics and is hosted in Switzerland.
notfound.title: Page not found

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.project: Rappespalter is an open-source project under the MIT license. Its source code, issues and releases are on GitHub.
imprint.liability.title: Disclaimer
imprint.liability.text: The content of this website is prepared with care, but without any guarantee that it is correct, complete or up to date. Rappespalter is a tool, not financial advice: decisions you make with it are your own. Linked websites are the responsibility of their operators.
dp.title: Privacy notice
dp.intro: This notice explains which personal data is processed when you visit this website, as required by the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP). In short: as little as possible.
dp.hosting.title: Hosting and server logs
dp.hosting.text: This website is hosted by {host} on servers in Switzerland. Like every web server, theirs records each request: your IP address, the date and time, the page requested, the page you came from and your browser's identification. This is needed to deliver the website and to protect it against attacks. {host} processes this data on our behalf in Switzerland. It isn't passed on to anyone else and is deleted once it's no longer needed for these purposes.
dp.none.title: What this website doesn't do
dp.none.text: It sets no cookies, uses no analytics or tracking, shows no ads and embeds no social media. Fonts, images and videos come from this website's own server, so opening a page contacts no one else. If you pick a language in the header, your browser remembers it (in its local storage); that never leaves your device.
dp.links.title: Links to GitHub
dp.links.text: The download buttons and the links to the source code lead to GitHub, run by GitHub, Inc. in the USA. Once you follow such a link, GitHub's own privacy statement applies.
dp.email.title: Email
dp.email.text: If you send an email, your address and message are used only to answer it and are not passed on.
dp.app.title: The app
dp.app.text: This notice covers the website. The Rappespalter app keeps your financial data on your own computer; what it sends online, and when, is listed in the privacy section on the home page.
dp.rights.title: Your rights
dp.rights.text: You can ask which data about you is processed, and have it corrected or deleted, by writing to the email address above. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
